links.comparator_used: Centralized learning (CL) on pooled data from the same 6 institutions
links.outcome: Tooth segmentation accuracy (Dice, ASSD) on a hold-out test set under baseline, label-manipulation, image-noise and faulty-client-exclusion settings
links.effect: Baseline median Dice 0.949 (ASSD 1.332) FL vs 0.947 (ASSD 1.371) CL; label manipulation 0.949 (ASSD 1.465) vs 0.942 (ASSD 1.757); image noise 0.949 (ASSD 1.311) vs 0.948 (ASSD 1.361); faulty client excluded 0.948 (ASSD 1.331) vs 0.946 (ASSD 1.393). With 2 noisy clients CL performed slightly better than FL.
links.quote: FL matches or exceeds CL and outperforms LL across corruption scenarios while preserving privacy.

design_hint: per-client loss monitoring for anomaly detection and excluding faulty client data in federated learning
